name: MCP Apps
summary: MCP Apps is an official extension to the Model Context Protocol that lets an MCP tool declare an interactive HTML interface. The host fetches a ui:// resource from the server, renders it in a sandboxed iframe in the conversation, and talks to it over a postMessage JSON-RPC dialect so the app can call tools and update the model's context.
facts: MCP extension; tools link UI via _meta.ui.resourceUri
Claude, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, VS Code GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Goose, Postman
goodFor: One interactive tool UI that works across several chat hosts
Dashboards, forms and viewers inside a conversation
watchOut: Host support and capabilities vary by client
Iframe sandbox and CSP limit what the app can load
